home_producer_probe.scope: diagnostic-only; no action consumer or progress provider attached

local_behavior_probe.scope: same-meaning local source contracts for theme/category-navigation/own-process metric quantity; floating menu component and home status are NOT full original producers

acceptance_rule: visible/hittable/configurable/source contract alone never counts as original effect; device evidence and same-meaning consumer receipt are required.
receipt_invalidation: Exact consumer clear-frame receipt revokes actual. Keep stop obligation; preserve pendingStop generation/token; stale prior apply callbacks are rejected.

log_contracts.field_state: stage=field-state control=<stableID> capability=<domain> field=<fieldID> confirmed=<matched live receipt only> scope=<explicit> reason=<exact>
log_contracts.actual: stage=actual confirmed=<consumer declared fields only> result=<applied/notApplied/unavailable/failed> scope=consumer-declared-fields

local_appearance.receipt: observeAppearance: native-key integer theme + packed RGBA preference readback + actual UIView equality; appearanceChannel.receive token; floating palette preference is not original floating effect
local_appearance.scope: same-meaning local theme/default/Float32/persistence source contract; not pixel/device or original floating effect

lifecycle.stop: suspendGameConsumers -> local channel stop token -> observed editor dismissal -> restored/failed; native preferences intentionally retained

local_directory.receipt: observeDirectory: actual category selected trait/tint + exact catalog titles/count + typed group view state; directoryChannel.receive token; no accessibility-text parser
local_directory.scope: same-meaning local category index0..12/content switch/scroll reset, preserve group flags; not target item discovery/filter effect

lifecycle.stop: suspendGameConsumers -> local channel stop token -> observed editor dismissal -> restored/failed; category/group configuration retained

home_observation.receipt: observed supportedFields + snapshot; NOT an action receipt
home_observation.scope: this app initialization / target identity / hosted status observations

lifecycle.stop: observations disappear with source/scene; NOT an action restore receipt

performance_observation.receipt: getpid + observedAt age0..5s + independent cpu/footprint/peak valid flags + displayed UILabel readback; primary nonidle-thread sum only, diagnostic RUSAGE cannot confirm CPU
performance_observation.scope: same-meaning own-process metric quantity: Float32 nonidle THREAD_BASIC_INFO sum; TASK_VM_INFO phys_footprint/2^20; process-lifetime CAS peak; original MB label means MiB quantity, explicit own-app unit/scope retained

lifecycle.update: serialized sampler -> updatePerformanceObservation -> performanceValues getpid/age/independent validity -> actual UILabel text; no target PID
lifecycle.stop: stale/invalid source -> nil per-field display; process-lifetime footprint peak persists in same PID, resets only on PID change

frame_rate.receipt: applyFrameRate live Metal property readback == requested + same host generation + channel token match
frame_rate.scope: live MTKView preferred FPS property only; not measured presentation cadence; CA remains unavailable

lifecycle.update: refreshSchedulerObservation revokes old actual after host-generation/value/readiness mismatch

player.receipt: requestToken+hostGeneration+configRevision+snapshotID + target lease identity + <=0.5s freshness + local renderer accepted
player.scope: declared read-only player fields; local layout/glyph/image subsets are not full native effect proof

adjustments.receipt: requestToken+hostGeneration+configRevision+snapshotID + live source lane identity + local renderer accepted
adjustments.scope: declared local render style fields only

lifecycle.update: consumed exact local receipt with live source lanes

radar.receipt: both ownedLanes receipts + requestToken+hostGeneration+configRevision+snapshotID + target lease identity + <=0.5s freshness
radar.scope: declared radar/warning subset; primary yaw scope only

lifecycle.update: capture -> both ownedLanes consumed; nil/stale -> both clear receipts -> invalidateReadFrameObservation
lifecycle.stop: stop -> both ownedLanes clear receipts -> restored/failed
